observations.territory: All60 observed frames retain complementary ownership; newly bright Purple extends north along the measured irregular front while Orange recedes. No global repaint, hard straight sweep, camera-independent drift or abrupt whole-mask switch is visible. Early west micro-islands reflect existing coarse coastal country geometry and are less detailed than source coast.
observations.camera: Every consecutive thumbnail shows steady geography tracking and scale progression; no sudden jump, hard cut, black corner or wrong-locus motion is visible. Units remain near the moving front rather than floating against unrelated terrain. Initial orientation and early pan match the side-by-side target far more closely than the previous reproduction.
observations.actors: Eight faction badges remain consistently visible: three upper Orange-side and five lower Purple-side. No unmotivated pop-in, random explosion, aircraft or nuclear symbol is visible in the covered2s. Small source combat-contact accents are not fully resolved at180px thumbnail size; no claim of exact contact timing.
observations.rhythm: Camera/terrain translation, front growth and actor motion continue through the covered frames without an empty intro or a visible dead hold. Reference early action rhythm is recognizable. Contact-sheet observation cannot fully certify perceived30fps smoothness.
observations.map: Olive land/Teal ocean are closer in palette, and the final corrected existing-Purple style retains visible terrain. However source relief and coastal/bathymetric texture remain sharper and richer; Candidate sea and hills remain softer/flatter.
observations.color_clarity: Orange vs Purple and brighter gained Purple are readable without captions; existing vs gained Purple changes do not cause a global flash. Candidate orange is somewhat darker/redder than source.
observations.strict_exclusions: No decorative arrow, route trace, direction guide or added frontier stroke is visible in any of the60 covered frames. Badge outlines remain part of their graphic design, not movement guides.
